objective: Targeted search for RGB intraoral photographs with whole-tooth instance annotations and genuine FDI numbering.
search_was_not: broad generic dental search; no large downloads; no API keys
venues_checked: Figshare (via search; no additional RGB+FDI dump verified)
Scientific Data / JDS / J Dent / arXiv

candidates_ranked.license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 + DUA 1.5.0; required training CITI Data or Specimens Only Research
candidates_ranked.annotation_count: 1800 bounding boxes on photographs; 2892 tooth-level CSV labels (F/D/N)
candidates_ranked.annotation_format: JPEG photos; CSV (patient, FDI tooth number, F/D/N); JSON MakeSense boxes
candidates_ranked.exact_classes: UNVERIFIED as a full exported class list. Source states 12 anterior teeth (incisors and canines, both arches) labelled with FDI two-digit numbering. Posterior 14-18/24-28/34-38/44-48 not in scope.
candidates_ranked.rgb_verification: VERIFIED at original source: high-resolution intraoral JPEG 5760x3840; paper Fig. 3(a) is an intraoral photograph; Fig. 5 shows original intraoral images with rectangular boxes. Files themselves not downloaded.
candidates_ranked.whole_tooth_box_verification: VERIFIED at source text: 1800 boxes on intraoral photographs around anterior teeth (not caries lesions). Box count (1800) is less than 241*12, so coverage of every anterior tooth is UNVERIFIED without opening JSON.
candidates_ranked.fdi_verification: VERIFIED: CSV uses International Dental Federation / FDI World Dental Federation two-digit numbering. Box JSON is described as showing FD status per anterior tooth, not as 32-class FDI detector labels.
candidates_ranked.download_access: Credentialed PhysioNet users who complete CITI and sign DUA. Not anonymous public download. Download NOT PERFORMED.
candidates_ranked.commercial_use: UNVERIFIED (credentialed health DUA typically restricts; quote DUA before any commercial ICCC use)
candidates_ranked.iccc_suitability: Only verified RGB+tooth-instance+FDI source. Anterior-only; not a full 32-tooth camera detector. Do not train camera ICDAS on CBCT. Do not map F/D/N to ICDAS.

candidates_ranked.license: Code MIT (repo). Weights: SegmentAnyTooth Non-Commercial License via signed email. Image dataset: not posted.

candidates_ranked.annotation_format: CVAT; YOLO11 boxes + SAM masks (in the paper/code pipeline, not a public dump)
candidates_ranked.exact_classes: FDI notations; lateral views exclude second premolar through third molar. Exact 32-list UNVERIFIED in files.

candidates_ranked.whole_tooth_box_verification: VERIFIED in paper (YOLO11 whole-tooth boxes + FDI). Files not public.
candidates_ranked.fdi_verification: VERIFIED in paper (Federation Dentaire Internationale). Files not public.
candidates_ranked.download_access: Images NOT PUBLIC. Weights by email agreement only.
candidates_ranked.iccc_suitability: Clinically the best match if authors release data. Not usable today.
